mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_ROLE (ID, ROLE_ID, TENANT_ID, ORG_ID, ROLE_CODE, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_DESC, ROLE_SCOPE, ROLE_TYPE, TENANT_REF_ID, APP_REF_ID, ROLE_STATUS, VERSION, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID, IS_DELETE) VALUES (#{id}, #{roleId}, #{tenantId}, 'TENANT', #{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{roleDesc}, 'TENANT', 'TENANT', #{tenantRefId}, #{appRefId}, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{createdTime}, #{creatorId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT R.ID AS id, R.TENANT_REF_ID AS tenantRefId, R.APP_REF_ID AS appRefId, R.ROLE_CODE AS roleCode, R.ROLE_TYPE AS roleType, R.ROLE_STATUS AS roleStatus, R.VERSION AS version, R.IS_DELETE AS isDelete FROM PEACH_ROLE R INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = R.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' INNER JOIN PEACH_APPLICATION A ON A.ID = R.APP_REF_ID AND A.TENANT_ID = T.TENANT_ID AND A.IS_DELETE = 0 AND A.IS_OPEN = 1 WHERE R.ID = #{roleRefId} AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND R.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId} AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT PERMISSION_REF_ID FROM PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION WHERE TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND ROLE_REF_ID = #{roleRefId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND IS_DELETE = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION (ID, TENANT_REF_ID, ROLE_REF_ID, PERMISSION_REF_ID, STATUS, IS_DELETE, VERSION, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantRefId}, #{roleRefId}, #{permissionRefId}, 'ACTIVE', 0, 0, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{operatorRefId})
mapper.update: UPDATE PEACH_ROLE SET VERSION = VERSION + 1, MODIFY_TIME = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), MODIFIER_ID = #{operatorRefId} WHERE TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId} AND ID = #{roleRefId} AND VERSION = #{version} AND IS_DELETE = 0 AND ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
